fraction bhaneko kunai puro chij ko bhag ho. jastai euta roti lai 4 baraabar tukra garera 1 tukra khanu bhayo bhane 1/4 khanu bhayo. mathi ko sankhya (ansh) le kati bhag liyo bhanchha, tala ko (har) le jamma kati bhag ma baadeko bhanchha.

messages.steps: har farak chha, tyasaile saman har banaune. 2 ra 3 ko LCM 6. 1/2 = 3/6, 1/3 = 2/6. 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.

messages.content: 2/3 x 9/10 ko answer simplest form ma deu

messages.steps: ansh x ansh: 2 x 9 = 18. har x har: 3 x 10 = 30. 18/30 lai 6 le bhag garda 3/5.

cross gunne: 5 x 5 = 25 ra 3 x 8 = 24. 25 > 24, tyasaile 5/8 > 3/5. dasamlab ma: 0.625 ra 0.6.

messages.content: percent bhaneko 'prati saya' ho. 30% bhaneko 100 ma 30. jastai 100 rupiya ko 30% = 30 rupiya, ra 200 rupiya ko 30% = 60 rupiya. percent le kunai sankhya lai 100 bhag ma herera tulana garna sajilo banauchha.

ani feri 20% sasto bhayo bhane 50 mai farkinchha?

messages.steps: aba 20% chai 60 ko lagchha: 60 x 20 / 100 = 12. 60 - 12 = 48. badhda sano mol ko 20% thiyo, ghatda thulo mol ko 20%, tyasaile 2 rupiya ghati bhayo.

messages.content: LCM bhaneko k ho? 4 ra 6 ko udaharan dinus

messages.steps: LCM bhaneko duitai sankhya le nishesh bhag lagne sabai bhanda sano sankhya. 4 ko gunan: 4, 8, 12, 16. 6 ko gunan: 6, 12, 18. pahilo saajha 12.

messages.content: 3 ota bell 3, 5 ra 10 minet ma bajchhan. sangai bajepachhi feri kati minet ma sangai bajchhan?

messages.steps: yo LCM ko prashna ho. 3 ra 5 ko LCM 15. 15 ra 10 ko LCM 30. jaach: 30 lai 3, 5 ra 10 le bhag lagchha.

messages.content: what is the difference between HCF and LCM, with an example?

HCF (highest common factor) is the biggest number that divides both numbers. LCM (lowest common multiple) is the smallest number that both numbers divide into. For 24 and 36: HCF is 12, because 12 divides both; LCM is 72, because 72 is the first number in both times tables. A handy check: HCF x LCM = 24 x 36, and 12 x 72 = 864 = 24 x 36.

messages.content: 8 m lamo ra 5 m chaudai kotha ko area ra perimeter?
area 40 varga meter ra perimeter 26 meter.
messages.steps: area = lambai x chaudai = 8 x 5 = 40 m2. perimeter = 2 x (8 + 5) = 2 x 13 = 26 m.

messages.content: area ra perimeter ma farak k ho? confuse hunchha

perimeter bhaneko kunai aakriti ko chhewai chhewa ghumda ko jamma lambai ho, jastai bagaincha ma baar lagaune lambai. area bhaneko bhitra ko satah kati chha bhanne, jastai bhuin ma kati carpet chahinchha. perimeter meter ma napinchha, area varga meter ma. jastai 3 m ko square ko perimeter 12 m, area 9 m2.
euta square ko ek bhuja 7 cm chha, area kati?

messages.steps: square ko area = bhuja x bhuja = 7 x 7 = 49 cm2. perimeter chahiyo bhane 4 x 7 = 28 cm.

messages.content: tribhuj ko aadhar 10 cm ra uchai 6 cm. area?

messages.steps: area = 1/2 x aadhar x uchai = 1/2 x 10 x 6 = 30 cm2.

messages.content: 6 m x 4 m ko bhuin ma tile halne. area kati?
ek tile 50 cm x 50 cm ko bhaye kati tile chahinchha?

messages.steps: ek tile = 0.5 x 0.5 = 0.25 m2. 24 / 0.25 = 96. arko tarika: lambai ma 6 / 0.5 = 12, chaudai ma 4 / 0.5 = 8, 12 x 8 = 96.

messages.content: ausat bhaneko k ho ani kina kaam lagchha?

ausat (average) bhaneko sabai sankhya jodera kati wata chhan tyasle bhag gareko maan ho. yo le 'saamanya rup ma kati' bhanchha. jastai 3 din ma 2, 4 ra 6 ghanta padhnu bhayo bhane jamma 12, 12 / 3 = 4, arthat din ko ausat 4 ghanta. marks, taapkram, kharcha tulana garna kaam lagchha.

naya jamma: 300 + 120 = 420. sankhya 6. 420 / 6 = 70.

messages.content: prime number k ho? 1 prime ho?

prime number tyo ho jaslai 1 ra afai le matra nishesh bhag lagchha, jastai 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. 1 prime haina, kinaki usko gunankhanda euta matra chha (1); prime ko thik 2 wata gunankhanda hunuparchha. 2 chai ek matra jor prime ho.
1 dekhi 30 samma ka prime numbers list garnus

messages.steps: har sankhya lai 2, 3, 5 le jaachne (30 ko varga mool 6 bhanda kam, tyasaile yati pugchha). 9, 15, 21, 25, 27 jasta bijor sankhya 3 ki 5 le kattinchhan.
2 le bhag lagdaina (bijor). 3: 9 + 1 = 10, lagdaina. 5: antim 1, lagdaina. 7: 7 x 13 = 91, lagyo. tyasaile prime haina.

The square root of 97 is a bit under 10, so check 2, 3, 5, 7. 97 is odd; digit sum 16 is not divisible by 3; it does not end in 0 or 5; 7 x 13 = 91 and 7 x 14 = 98, so 7 does not divide it. No divisor found, so 97 is prime.
